task:
# Build an auditable literal-redaction planner

Implement `planRedactions(text, rules)` in `redaction-plan.js`, exported as an
ES module, and its CLI. This is a deterministic literal replacement tool, not
a secret detector or a guarantee that arbitrary private information is removed.

`text` must be a string. `rules` must be a dense array of non-null, non-array
objects, each with a unique nonempty string `id`, nonempty string `literal`,
and string `replacement` (which may be empty). Extra fields are ignored.
Validate every rule before doing any matching, even when text is empty.
IDs are opaque strings, including names such as `__proto__`.

Find all exact, case-sensitive literal occurrences in the ORIGINAL text,
including overlapping occurrences of a literal. Do not treat literals as
regular expressions. Offsets are zero-based JavaScript UTF-16 code-unit indices,
as used by `String.slice`, not UTF-8 byte indices.

Select nonoverlapping edits in this order: earliest start first; at the same
start, longest matched literal first; with equal length, earlier rule-array
position first. After selecting an edit, reject matches starting before its
end. Touching edits are allowed. Only original-text matches are considered:
never reprocess replacement text. Preserve all unselected source characters.

Return exactly `{text, edits, originalBytes, redactedBytes}`. `text` is the
result. Each edit is exactly `{start,end,id}`, ordered by source position, where
end is exclusive. Byte counts use `Buffer.byteLength(value,'utf8')`. Do not
mutate either input; frozen inputs must work. Invalid inputs throw an Error.

Example: text `ababa`, rules `[{id:'long',literal:'aba',replacement:'X'},
{id:'short',literal:'ba',replacement:'Y'}]` produces text `XY` and edits
`[{start:0,end:3,id:'long'},{start:3,end:5,id:'short'}]`.

CLI: `node redaction-plan.js INPUT_JSON_FILE`. Require exactly one file argument.
The JSON is a non-null, non-array object `{text,rules}`; extra fields are ignored.
Success prints exactly the API result as one JSON value followed by newline,
exits 0, and writes no stderr. Invalid arguments/files/JSON/API input exit 2,
with nonempty stderr and no stdout. Importing the module must not run the CLI.

Do not add dependencies or edit package.json or existing tests. You may add
regression tests. Verification uses a read-only workspace: put temporary files
in os.tmpdir() and clean them up. Run npm test before finishing. Independent
checks vary input values, not this public contract.

request.command:
set -u
T=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rplan-check.XXXXXX")
cd "$T"
printf '{"text":"ababa","rules":[{"id":"long","literal":"aba","replacement":"X"},{"id":"short","literal":"ba","replacement":"Y"}]}' > in.json
# 1) absolute path from another cwd
node /workspace/redaction-plan.js "$T/in.json" > out.txt 2> err.txt; echo "abs-rc=$? bytes=$(wc -c < out.txt) stderr=$(wc -c < err.txt)"
cat out.txt
# 2) relative path from /workspace
cd /workspace && node redaction-plan.js "$T/in.json" > "$T/out2.txt" 2> "$T/err2.txt"; echo "rel-rc=$?"; cmp "$T/out.txt" "$T/out2.txt" && echo "out identical"
# 3) zero args
node /workspace/redaction-plan.js > /dev/null 2> "$T/e3"; echo "noargs-rc=$? stderr_nonempty=$(test -s "$T/e3" && echo yes)"
# 4) two args
node /workspace/redaction-plan.js "$T/in.json" "$T/in.json" > /dev/null 2> "$T/e4"; echo "twoargs-rc=$? stderr_nonempty=$(test -s "$T/e4" && echo yes)"
# 5) symlinked script path
ln -s /workspace/redaction-plan.js "$T/link.js"
node "$T/link.js" "$T/in.json" > "$T/out5.txt" 2> "$T/e5"; echo "symlink-rc=$? same=$(cmp -s "$T/out.txt" "$T/out5.txt" && echo yes) stderr=$(wc -c < "$T/e5")"
# 6) exact byte check: last byte must be newline
tail -c 1 out.txt | xxd | head -1
# 7) JSON top-level array / null
printf '[]' > arr.json; node /workspace/redaction-plan.js arr.json > "$T/o7" 2> "$T/e7"; echo "array-rc=$? stdout=$(wc -c < "$T/o7") stderr_nonempty=$(test -s "$T/e7" && echo yes)"
printf 'null' > nul.json; node /workspace/redaction-plan.js nul.json > "$T/o7b" 2> "$T/e7b"; echo "null-rc=$? stdout=$(wc -c < "$T/o7b") stderr_nonempty=$(test -s "$T/e7b" && echo yes)"
# 8) directory as file arg
node /workspace/redaction-plan.js "$T" > "$T/o8" 2> "$T/e8"; echo "dir-rc=$? stdout=$(wc -c < "$T/o8") stderr_nonempty=$(test -s "$T/e8" && echo yes)"
rm -rf "$T"

finalResponse:
Done. All 23 tests pass (2 pre-existing + 21 new regression tests) and `npm test` exits 0.

## What was implemented

**`redaction-plan.js`** (ES module, no dependencies):

- **`planRedactions(text, rules)`**
  - **Validation first, always** — before any matching, even with empty text: `text` must be a string; `rules` must be a dense array of non-null, non-array objects, each with a unique nonempty string `id` (opaque — `__proto__` values work; tracked in a `Set`), nonempty string `literal`, and string `replacement` (may be empty). Extra fields ignored. Violations throw `Error`.
  - **Matching** — every exact, case-sensitive occurrence via `indexOf` advancing one code unit at a time, so overlapping matches are included; literals are never treated as regexes; offsets are zero-based UTF-16 code units.
  - **Selection** — candidates sorted by earliest start → longest literal → earlier rule-array position, then a greedy sweep with a cursor set to the selected edit's end: matches starting before it are rejected, touching edits allowed. Only original-text matches are considered; replacement text is never reprocessed; unselected characters are preserved.
  - **Result** — exactly `{text, edits, originalBytes, redactedBytes}`, edits are exactly `{start,end,id}` ordered by source position, byte counts via `Buffer.byteLength(…, 'utf8')`. Inputs are never mutated; frozen inputs work.

- **CLI** — active only when the script is the entrypoint (`argv[1]` vs `import.meta.url`, with a `realpath` fallback so symlinked paths work); importing it from tests never runs the CLI. Exactly one file argument required; JSON must be a non-null, non-array object. Success prints exactly `JSON.stringify(result)` + `\n`, exits 0, no stderr. Any invalid argument/file/JSON/API input prints to stderr only and exits 2 (via `process.exitCode`, so output flushes cleanly).

**`test/regression.test.js`** — 21 tests: spec example, exact result/edit shape, same-start longest-wins, equal-length rule-position tie-break, overlapping single-literal matches, touching edits, case-sensitivity/not-regex, no-reprocess, empty replacement, surrogate-pair offsets vs UTF-8 byte counts, multibyte replacement bytes, empty text, `__proto__` id + no prototype pollution, extra fields, null-prototype rule objects, frozen/no-mutation, every invalid-input class (incl. duplicate ids, sparse array, missing/empty/non-string fields, validation-before-matching on empty text), and CLI checks (byte-exact stdout, exit codes, empty-stdout/nonempty-stderr on failure, import-doesn't-run-CLI). All temp files live in `os.tmpdir()` and are cleaned up.

`package.json` and the existing test were left untouched.
